predicate.statistic: max of the available bearing, range and height z of the release against its record's largest kept cluster, refitted from the stored placement
predicate.gate: release only where the statistic exceeds gate_z; the repair's existing veto value, not tuned here
predicate.unmeasured: no ray or no fit: reported separately, never gated
predicate.pass: among measured right and wrong releases the gate keeps at least 50% of wrong releases and still releases at least 80% of right releases
predicate.review: frozen release_audit.json on the fresh proposal
predicate.confirm: the same gate and thresholds on both older folds, for releases whose identity the older look labels settle; both must pass
predicate.auc: reported only; no threshold is chosen from it

exploratory_after_failure.closest: z 0.57 releases 73% of right and keeps 46% of wrong

limitations: The older folds share 165 of the fresh releases' observations; the confirmation is a second labeller, not a second recording.
Exploratory checks were run after the predeclared test failed and select nothing.
Placements are refitted from kept clusters whose own purity is not established.
Development snapshot only; not independent acceptance.
